title: Warehouse picker drops SQL warehouses when the Databricks JSON response is compact
answers: mlflow agent setup warehouse list is missing some SQL warehouses
warehouse selection menu shows fewer warehouses than Databricks returns
compact JSON response loses warehouses in setup.sh
awk JSON parsing drops entries from warehouse dropdown
body:
Symptom: In the `mlflow agent setup` warehouse selection menu, some SQL warehouses that exist on the workspace do not appear when the API response is returned as single-line (compact) JSON.
Root cause: mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh:select_warehouse used awk rules that run once per input line; with several objects on one line, only the last id/name/state match survived, so earlier warehouses were lost.
Fix pattern: Split every "id", "name" and "state" key onto its own line with sed before awk, then have awk emit a row via emit_if_complete() as soon as all three fields are captured, so field order and line layout no longer matter (mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh:json_warehouse_rows).
Constraints: Covers flat string fields of the warehouse list response only; it is not a general JSON parser and nested objects are not handled. Any new parser of Databricks JSON in setup.sh should go through the same line-normalising approach rather than per-line awk rules.
applies: Shell-side JSON parsing in mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh; applies to any response the wizard parses with awk.
says: Some SQL warehouses are missing from the agent setup selection dropdown
The warehouse picker in the setup wizard shows fewer items than actually exist
Warehouses disappear from the configuration menu when the workspace returns compact responses
Ensure every available SQL warehouse appears in the agent configuration list
Setup wizard skips earlier warehouses when multiple entries are received on one line
search: In `mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh`, compact single-line JSON responses caused the warehouse selection menu to drop entries because per-line `awk` parsing retained only the last match. The fix splits `id`, `name`, and `state` keys onto separate lines with `sed` before `awk` emits a row via `emit_if_complete()` in `json_warehouse_rows`. Applies to shell-side Databricks JSON parsing in `mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh`, covering flat string fields only and excluding nested objects.
